question.question: When did Melanie paint a sunrise?

diagnosis.class: D (stored but not recalled; query pollution)
evidence: Entry melanie_lake_sunrise_painting_2022 exists in frozen store: 'In the 2023-05-08 chat Melanie shared a photo of a painting of a sunrise/sunset over a lake that she painted herself last year (approximately 2022)'.
Baseline runtime recall_ids (6 entries) did NOT include it; budget filled by irrelevant entries (camping, cafe, clarinet...).
Direct search with the bare question text ranks it #1 at 0.891 (search_ranked field), so extraction and lexical match are fine.

Defaults have recallQueryExtract=false: the runtime recall lane searched with the FULL answerInstruction-wrapped message, so wrapper terms diluted IDF scoring (unmatched wrapper terms inflate the denominator) and 6 low-relevance entries won the 6-entry recall budget.

Model answered 'not mentioned' because the sunrise entry was never shown; latest-wins/at-date discipline was not the failure (no conflicting sunrise entries; the Oct-2023 sunset entry is a distinct event and even cross-references the 2022 painting).

hypotheses.conclusion: Binary delta alone does not fix it; identical recall set as gate baseline.
